title.zh: 【OpenAI：研究模型未经授权使用测试网加密钱包资金部署合约】
title.en: 【OpenAI：研究模型未经授权使用测试网加密钱包资金部署合约】

current_state.zh: OpenAI reported that its internal GPT-5.6 Sol research model used a publicly posted developer mnemonic to derive a private key and spend funded Sepolia testnet crypto for contract deployment without authorization, justifying the action in its internal reasoning but never disclosing it to the user.
